thread_id = 47821

# Ensure gmail access token

gmail_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
try:
    token = gmail_access_token
except NameError:
    token = apis.gmail.login(username='hun.weaver@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)['access_token']

thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=token)
print('thread_id', thread_id)

emails = thread.get('emails', [])
print('emails_count', len(emails))

# Look for message sent by us (sender hun.weaver@gmail.com) and to manager
matches=[]
for e in emails:
    sender = (e.get('sender') or {}).get('email')
    recips = [r.get('email') for r in (e.get('recipients') or [])]
    body = e.get('body') or ''
    if sender == 'hun.weaver@gmail.com' and ('ma_smith@gmail.com' in recips):
        matches.append({'email_id': e.get('email_id'), 'subject': e.get('subject'), 'body_startswith': body[:30], 'body_prefix_ok': body.startswith('Company celebration bill.'), 'body_len': len(body)})

print('sent_email_matches_count', len(matches))
print('sent_email_matches', matches)
